title: Export a task's full log as JSON or Markdown
plan:
Add task log export functionality: a backend route /api/task/:taskId/export that returns JSON or Markdown attachments, a new pure service file for formatting, unit tests for the markdown formatter, and frontend client + UI to download logs.
1. Create new pure formatter service backend/src/services/taskExport.ts
2. Add export route to backend router: GET /api/task/:taskId/export
3. Add vitest tests for markdown formatter
4. Add exportTaskLog client function to frontend/src/api/client.ts
5. Add Download log control to TaskView to call export API and trigger download
requirements: Add GET /api/task/:taskId/export?format=json|markdown to backend router with same auth & access checks used by other task routes
If format=json (default) respond with pretty-printed JSON body: { task: <task detail>, metrics, events } and Content-Disposition attachment filename task-<first8> .json and appropriate Content-Type

If format=markdown respond with a markdown transcript per spec (title with issue number/title, metrics summary: duration, LLM calls, tool calls, cost; events grouped by step with headings '## Step N — <description>', tool calls as bullets (tool name + short args) and agent thoughts as blockquotes), set Content-Disposition filename task-<first8>.md and appropriate Content-Type
Return 404 if task not found, 400 with JSON { error } for unknown formats
Put formatting logic in new backend/src/services/taskExport.ts as pure functions and add vitest tests that assert the markdown formatter output
Add frontend exportTaskLog(taskId, format) in frontend/src/api/client.ts that downloads the file (fetch → blob → object URL → temporary <a download>)
Add a Download log control in frontend/src/pages/TaskView.tsx offering JSON and Markdown and using the client function to download
Ensure TypeScript builds (npx tsc -b) for backend and frontend continue to pass after changes
summary:
Added task log export feature.

Backend: created backend/src/services/taskExport.ts with pure helpers filenameFor, jsonPayload, formatMarkdown. Added GET /api/task/:taskId/export route in backend/src/api/router.ts which verifies access, gathers task detail/events/metrics, and returns either pretty JSON attachment or Markdown attachment with appropriate Content-Type and Content-Disposition; returns 404 for missing task and 400 for unknown format.

Tests: added Vitest test backend/src/services/__tests__/taskExport.test.ts to assert markdown formatter output; backend tests pass.

Frontend: added exportTaskLog(taskId, format) in frontend/src/api/client.ts which fetches the endpoint, creates a blob, and triggers a download via a temporary <a>. Added Download JSON/Markdown buttons to frontend/src/pages/TaskView.tsx that call the client function.

Verification: ran TypeScript build for frontend (npx tsc -b) and backend (npx tsc --noEmit -p .) and ran backend tests (npm test) — all passed. Assumptions: task detail retrieval uses checkpointStore/registry/getTaskDetailFromDb as available in router; event shapes used by formatter align with backend/src/events/types.ts. No other unrelated pre-existing failures were modified.


Requirements:
1. R1: GET route added in backend/src/api/router.ts with access checks using assertTaskAccess and registry/checkpointStore
2. R2: JSON export implemented using taskExport.jsonPayload and Content-Disposition filename task-<8>.json in router.ts
3. R3: Markdown export implemented using taskExport.formatMarkdown and Content-Disposition filename task-<8>.md in router.ts
4. R4: 404 returned when task not found; 400 returned for unknown format in router.ts
5. R5: Formatting logic implemented in backend/src/services/taskExport.ts and vitest tests added in backend/src/services/__tests__/taskExport.test.ts
6. R6: frontend/src/api/client.ts exportTaskLog added to download the file via blob/object URL and temporary anchor
7. R7: frontend/src/pages/TaskView.tsx Download controls added calling exportTaskLog
8. R8: TypeScript builds and backend tests verified: frontend tsc -b and backend tsc/tests passed
